project.definition: Provide the compact authoritative state foundation used by every playable world and fork: immutable versioned content is shared, mutable match facts have stable identity, and equivalent seeded executions have deterministic state witnesses. Consumer performance now belongs to the running Search and Study Runtime Prototype.

krs.text: Every environment and branch shares one versioned ContentPack while mutable-state cloning duplicates no immutable card definitions, with independently reset roots and siblings remaining isolated.

Stable CardDefId-based definitions and versioned deterministic state witnesses reproduce equivalent seeded traces without allocation-address, Debug-format, or card-name identity at the state boundary.

task.name: Prove ContentPack sharing and clone allocation boundary
task.description: Prove Runtime State Foundation KR1 without restoring the withdrawn W2-179 performance claims. Add focused executable Rust coverage showing that independently created environments for the same admitted content version and every exact search/root/sibling clone retain the same immutable Arc<ContentPack> identity/content digest, while mutable MatchState facts remain branch-isolated. Add deterministic allocation measurements that distinguish Arc/reference bookkeeping and mutable-state cloning from immutable ContentPack/CardDefinition storage, including a pack-size variation or equivalent controlled check proving clone allocations do not scale with immutable definition bytes. Record the measurement method, workload, build profile, source revision, hardware, raw counts/bytes, and failure threshold in a checked artifact or test output. Preserve Python and fixed-action ABIs. Do not implement undo/page-COW, select a branching design, duplicate W2-197/W2-207, or claim general step/rollout performance. All Python commands must use uv; rebuild the PyO3 extension after Rust changes. Once W2-196 has landed, rebase immediately before headless lf pr land -c; never use lf pr submit.

task.name: Add deterministic MatchState hash and identity boundary checks
task.description: Implement a versioned deterministic hash contract over mutable MatchState facts plus the shared ContentPack schema/content identity. Hashes must be independent of allocation addresses and Debug formatting, match across independently constructed games following the same seeded fixed-action trace, remain equal across clones, and change for meaningful state mutations. Make CardDefId the typed state-boundary identity and add a source-level or structural guard against card-name dispatch there; card names may remain compatibility projections for the current Python/observation ABI. Add positive and negative Rust tests and document hash versioning/canonical ordering. Preserve Python and fixed-action ABIs. Exclude W2-182's benchmark harness and throughput/RSS scenarios, ObjectRef/incarnation work, clone-plus-undo/page-COW, and unrelated rules or catalog expansion. Follow AGENTS.md: all Python commands through uv and rebuild the PyO3 extension after Rust changes.
